async def act(page):
    # Click the due date textbox to open the date picker
    due_date_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Use the arrow keys to pick a date")
    await due_date_textbox.click()
    
    # Select 'January' from the month combobox
    month_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox").first  # First combobox is for month
    await month_combobox.select_option("January")
    
    # Select '2030' from the year combobox
    year_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox").nth(1)  # Second combobox is for year
    await year_combobox.select_option("2030")
    
    # Click the button for day '3' in the grid
    day_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="3")
    await day_button.click()
